cases.failure: fresh native input waits for durable thread callback: failed journal
cases.control: fresh native input waits for durable thread callback: normal control
cases.invariant: Native turn/start requires successful durable handoff of the new thread identity.

cases.failure: peer independent interactions must survive local backend exec
cases.control: peer independent interactions must survive local backend app-server
cases.invariant: Remote native interaction observation follows the selected host capability, not the local backend setting.
cases.productionReachability: loadConfig/saveConfig normalize exec to app-server before normal service use
cases.reachabilityTest: production configuration normalizes retired exec to the single App Server

cases.failure: receive transport error must not detach running task card
cases.control: receive transport starting must not detach running task card
cases.invariant: A live receive monitor reporting connection failure does not remove bound thread observation or retire its card.

cases.failure: workspace save preserves later edits: slow response
cases.control: workspace save preserves later edits: normal control
cases.invariant: An earlier save receipt must not clear the dirty state of later editor content.

cases.failure: accepted active snapshot still updates progress: old receipt unavailable
cases.control: accepted active snapshot still updates progress: normal control
cases.invariant: Old input acceptance reconciliation failure must not discard independently confirmed read-only active progress; final effects remain gated.
